sync-readmes.//: Per example under starter/ and advanced/: runs `dotnet run --dry-run` to emit Metadata/dag-merged.md via the Mermaid extension, then splices it into the example's README between the <!-- flowthru:mermaid:start --> / <!-- flowthru:mermaid:end --> markers. Missing READMEs are scaffolded; missing markers are appended at EOF; examples whose dry-run fails (e.g. live-infra dependencies) are skipped with a warning.
